firstPlayerRule: The player dealt the green-shaded Level 1 engine takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If you cannot use the marked engine to choose a starter, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Setup deals each player a Level 1 engine and five cards at random. Turns then proceed clockwise, with two actions per turn.
This source covers the original Isle of Trains, not Isle of Trains: All Aboard.
